name: garmin-health
description: Garmin sleep, HRV, Body Battery, stress, activities and training load via Garmin's official Personal API, with history, charts, a calibrating readiness estimate, and coaching skills.

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Starts with GCDC_. Create it in Garmin Connect settings (Personal API). Leave empty to use GARMIN_API_KEY or ~/.config/garmin/connect-personal-api-key.
